title: PayPal Approval Token Credential
description: Single-use PayPal approval token forwarded in a UCP payment instrument on /complete. The merchant redeems it via PayPal Orders v2 as payment_source.token with type APPROVAL. Shared by the com.paypal.wallet handler and the paypal instrument of the com.paypal.payments (Unified) handler — the same approval-token flow.

token.description: Opaque, single-use PayPal approval token id, scoped to a fixed amount, currency, and payee.
